performance_tasks.brief: Seven-mark original thematic/resource mini-package: short knowledge and explanation parts totalling 5 A marks plus two evidence-reading B marks. Choose live commands and exact tariffs for each part. This is a teaching package, not a copied whole question. In integrated enquiry use content-linked interpretation, not a supposed Paper 1 fieldwork-method question.

Supply all resources and keys needed. In map skills use a consistent 1:50000 map; use actual licensed photographs where the outcome names photographs.

performance_tasks.brief: Five-mark judgement on a precise geographical claim with a verified named case where appropriate. Use How far do you agree; judge relevant facts and reach a supported decision. Four marks judge relevant facts and one credits the supported decision, which may be implied. Apply the 2024 demand without forcing equal-sided essays. In integrated enquiry apply the judgement to the supplied investigation evidence.

ao_mix_note: The syllabus states its AO weights as a share of MARKS, so planned_ao_mix_by_marks is the one that answers "does this resource match the exam". It values each card at the tariff of the question it models, split across the AOs the card declares, and values each performance task at the marks of the paper part it models. The count-based mix below is reported only because it is what a reader expects to see; do not balance against it. AO shares by ITEM COUNT: Every objective needs one recall anchor, so AO1 has a structural floor of about 74% in this topic (31 objectives against 42 slots) and cannot reach the None% target by count however many other cards are added - padding the bank to chase it makes the resource worse. The framework already measures the AO4 share in practice time rather than by count for the same reason. Treat AO1 above target as expected, and AO2/AO3/AO4 below target as the thing worth fixing.
